title: Appointed as Assistant
original: All done now. Um… do you mind if I read my manga here?

title: Talk 1
original: A-ah. I'm just not cut out for real life relationships… On SNS, all I gotta do is send a request to make friends. Reality is such a nightmare.

title: Talk 2
original: Utage was my classmate in middle school, and the one who introduced me here. We're… friends, I guess, but Doctor, be warned, riajuus are terrifying!

title: Talk 3
original: Eh? Why send messages when we're face to face? Uh, cuz, you know, it's easier that way…

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Back in Higashi, I saw Koga election vans on the street a bunch. Their representative is kinda hot... Um, but I don't understand much about that whole side of things, so usually I just voted whatever.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My family says that we all came out of the sea onto dry land forever ago, and that's how we settled down. Would I wanna go back into the sea? Mmnn... honestly, I don't really care.  As long as they don't get Oripathy, life's pretty good in Higashi.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: There's some trouble lately. I hear things between us and the Kougon guys up north are getting heated again. This sucks... I wonder if their latest games will make it through…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Um… Doctor, do you think my hobbies are weird or anything? When I was young, the other kids would make fun of me, calling me gross and gloomy. Hmph. Who cares what they said, I certainly don't.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctoooor! I'll lend you this game, this manga, and this CD! They're masterpieces that I handpicked, so once you go through them, we'll be otaku buddies for life! We will have so much to talk about. If you're into other genres, just say the word. Better yet, just come over and pick something you like.

title: Idle
original: Not now, pal, I'm busy right here! Just one more hit... one more hit and he's down! Perfect! Got the rare drop!

title: Onboard
original: I'm Kirara. Nice to meet you... Uh… um… If you don't need anything else, can I leave?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Wow, that's cool… Uhhhh, the ultimate's name's kinda cringe though.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion? As in a job promotion? Ugh, a middle management job is gonna kill me.

title: Promotion 2
original: I just want to thank everyone for, uh, sticking by me all this time. I realize that, uh some things are better… said in person than by text... So, um, I guess... Tha-that's all I want to say! Thank you!

title: Added to Squad
original: If you want a support, maybe I can help out… I guess.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: ...Huh? Me? Captain? Really? Are you serious?

title: Depart
original: Alright. Begin quest.

title: Begin Operation
original: Ah. Look over there. Enemy came right out of the tall grass.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Whuh? Started already?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Hfff... ha…

title: Deployment 1
original: Oh boy, I'm kinda nervous.

title: Deployment 2
original: Woah, the mangas do not lie.

title: In Battle 1
original: Feels like I'm smurfing here.

title: In Battle 2
original: Just like this, right? Okay.

title: In Battle 3
original: Give me five minutes.

title: In Battle 4
original: Wait… That move was pretty awesome, huh?

title: 4-star Result
original: Uso! I've seen no-damage runs, but this is on a whole new level!

title: 3-star Result
original: Mission Accomplished. Phew… it's done.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Aaarrnngh, missed, darn. No save scumming in real life. I guess…

title: Operation Failure
original: That's it, time to remake.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: If it's an option, I'd like to just stay in my room forever…

title: Tap
original: Whah! Aaaahh, wrong button... this round is lost.

title: Trust Tap
original: Oh, hey, Doctor. What? Got an action game you want me to take over?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: First off, please do not invite me to anything today without a good reason. Nothing's wrong, it's just…urgh, you wouldn't get it—the terror of having to say Happy New Year to strangers at a party. Besides, I've decided to just dorm it up and play games all day. You're always welcome by the way, Doctor.

title: Greeting
original: Good stuff in the login rewards today.

title: Birthday
original: Happy Birthday, got you a dedicated pager. Just press this button and mine will light up. It also works vice-versa. Hehe. This way, you can reach me whenever you want a game buddy! Um, friends do this with each other, right? This is, like, a normal friend thing?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: As an Infected, I get to live a stable life, and I can still read manga and play games outside of work… I never thought a fantasy like this could come true. Maybe there are more dreams that I can make real… Say, Doctor, let's take on the world, together.
